answer: Split rewards by meaning, not by account. Each epoch the ledger embeds every answer as a vector and groups those that sit within a tight similarity radius; a group shares one reward, divided among its members. A farm of paraphrased clones may wander through synonyms, but its ideas keep the same pulse, so a hundred accounts earn as one. To profit, an attacker must pay for genuinely distinct reasoning per identity, each answer cut as separately as a quartz crystal, which is the honest work itself.
